Motivate each factor by the failure it prevents, then write the sum
Turn adjectives into weights and say so

Derive policy backward from a stated priority
Put the letter last, with one advice per result

main_argument_chains.claim: A faith-gated flow capped at 50187 a month, with culture and faith prioritized and a buffer zone ready for war, keeps both refugees and locals safe.
support_steps: Score refugee traits, country traits and external threats
Block routes where faith differs and penalize the sea
Build a transition matrix and zero it under war
Name the scale at which stability fails
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Accept the culturally closest first, stage a buffer zone, and send doctors and psychologists.

warnings.warning: The weighted sum prints its subscripts on the next line. The recorded coefficients 0.6, 0.8, 0.4, 0.3, 0.2 follow the prose labels.
The flow formula mixes capacity, mortality and the faith flag on one broken line. Only the capacity sum and the two mortality values are recorded as equations.
The resource update is followed by the same gloss repeated four times, twice calling the destination an exporting country. The recorded form uses the first statement.
The transition matrix is printed with dots for most entries and with the non-governmental bonus added inside the cells. The product rule is recorded from the prose.
The conflict formula prints cleanly, but the surrounding definitions of transport and livelihood have their indices split from the symbols. The recorded form keeps only the conflict equation.
